messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: Could you clarify which chess tournament you're asking about? For example, are you interested in the World Chess Championship, the Chess Olympiad, or another specific event from 2015?
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which chess tournament? There are many tournaments. Possibly they refer to the World Chess Championship 2015? That was held in 2015 between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin. Carlsen won. But maybe they refer to the Chess Olympiad 2015? That was held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The team gold went to Russia. Or maybe they refer to the World Rapid Chess Championship 2015? That was won by Vladimir Kramnik. Or maybe they refer to the World Blitz Chess Championship 2015? That was won by Vladimir Kramnik as well. Or maybe they refer to the Chess.com Speed Chess Championship 2015? That was won by Hikaru Nakamura.

But the question is ambiguous. We need to ask clarifying question. According to policy, we should ask clarifying question if ambiguous. So we will ask: "Which chess tournament are you referring to?"
